sources: Public loader and tool documentation (BepInEx, HarmonyX, MelonLoader, RE-UE4SS, SKSE, Fabric, NeoForge, tModLoader, SMAPI and others), rehan-remade/universal-modder (MIT) as a cross-check, and a GitHub landscape survey of 1,723 game-modding repositories on 18/10/26. Paraphrased procedures only.
validation: Benchmarked 19/10/26: two hand-authored decision cases scored deterministically (scorer 2.3.0) against a baseline without the skill, one trial per arm on a frontier model in isolated no-tool sessions: case 1 2/4 without -> 4/4 with; case 2 2/4 without -> 3/4 with. Executable build task (bridge coordinate mapping): 7/7 without -> 7/7 with. Results at full marks in both arms are ceiling ties, not proof the skill adds nothing; single trials support no consistency claim.
